sign_convention: turn_angle = unwrapped heading change over the turn segment, end minus start; heading = atan2(vx, vy) in degrees mod 360, i.e. 0 = +y with the angle increasing clockwise (kinematics.heading_deg). A POSITIVE turn_angle is therefore a clockwise heading change and a NEGATIVE one is counter-clockwise. Direction of rotation is not the same as a body side: calling it left/right also needs to know whether +x lies to the player's right when he faces +y, and no field in these files records that.
label_basis: resolved=False; the orientation column o is expressed in the same frame as heading, so an agreement between the sign of the turn and the sign of the change in o proves the turn is a real body rotation in a consistent sense, but a mirrored (or y-flipped) frame would flip both together and cannot be detected from inside the data. Nothing in the Combine or game files records which side of a player +x lies on, so no body side is named
